content_text:
Thanks a lot for your reply and suggestions, about the subject! A strong script and professional approach definitely seems to be a good starting point.

It would also be interesting to hear from the experienced Cinematographers of the Forum who have deliberately chosen to work with first time directors and what the decisive factors were for them. Thanks to all!
